title: Every page at a pathname of its own language
lead: English lives at /about, Czech at /cs/o-nas, German at /de/ueber-uns — all three rendered by src/routes/about. The pathname gives the locale, so a link is all a language switch takes.

reroute.title: reroute
reroute.text: The universal hook serves each translated pathname from the route of its canonical one.

links.title: localizePath
links.text: Every link is written once, canonical, and translated to the locale it leads to.

loaders.title: Canonical routes
loaders.text: Loaders name /about and /products/[id] once, never a pathname per locale.
